-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics

def etcdstart.etcdKVAt [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions]
    (addr : GoString) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ : ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) (cid mid : w64) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(isGrpcRpc addr
        go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/Put"
        (client.etcdPutSpec E ρ.rd cid mid) ∗
      isGrpcRpcMd addr
          go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/Range"
          (client.etcdRangeSpecE E γr cid mid) ∗
        isGrpcRpc addr
            go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/DeleteRange"
            (client.etcdDeleteSpec E ρ.rd cid mid) ∗
          isGrpcRpc addr
              go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/Txn"
              (client.etcdTxnSpec E ρ.rd γr cid mid) ∗
            isGrpcRpc addr
              go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/Compact"
              (client.etcdCompactSpec E ρ.rd cid mid))

def etcdstart.srvWOf (E : apply.AEnv GF) (γr : ReadNames) (on : Bool) : v3rpc.SrvW GF :=
  { kv := E.kv, γm := E.γ, N := srvApi.kvsN, histLb := srvApi.histLb γr on E.γs, crevOk := srvApi.crevOk γr }

theorem etcdstart.etcdKVAt_eq [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (addr : GoString) (E : apply.AEnv
    GF) (ρ : ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) (cid mid : w64) : etcdstart.etcdKVAt addr E ρ γr cid mid =
    iprop(isGrpcRpc addr go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/Put" (client.etcdPutSpec E ρ.rd cid mid) ∗ isGrpcRpcMd
    addr go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/Range" (client.etcdRangeSpecE E γr cid mid) ∗ isGrpcRpc addr
    go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/DeleteRange" (client.etcdDeleteSpec E ρ.rd cid mid) ∗ isGrpcRpc addr
    go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/Txn" (client.etcdTxnSpec E ρ.rd γr cid mid) ∗ isGrpcRpc addr
    go!"/etcdserverpb.KV/Compact" (client.etcdCompactSpec E ρ.rd cid mid))

    grpcServeTok gs lis ∗ etcdstart.etcdKVAt addr E ρ γr cid mid

theorem etcdstart.memberUpOn_intro [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ :
    apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames GF) (id : w64) (γa : auth.AuthNames) (E : apply.AEnv
    GF) (cfg : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.config.ServerConfig) (γw : GName) : ⌜envAgree E E₀ ∧
    E.authMode = auth.AuthMode.on γa ∧ cfg.Logger' = lg ∧ cfg.TracerOptions' = slice.nil ∧
    cfg.WatchProgressNotifyInterval' = 0⌝ ∗ isServerReqM E.authOn s E { wait := γw, rd := ρ.rd } ∗
    isServerReadM E.authOn s E ρ.rd ∗ srvAuthLb s E ∗ srvWatchBuilt s E ∗ srvServeFacts s E cfg ∗
    srvGoRes s ∗ srvLgReader s ∗ srvBemuReader s ∗ srvWatchReaders s E 64 ∗ etcdstart.kvServeStocks
    s E ρ.rd ∗ etcdstart.srvPeerCtl γn s id ∗ □ (srvTLSId s -∗ False) ∗ srvAuthStoreOn s E.RD ⊢
    etcdstart.memberUpOn s ρ E₀ lg γn id γa

theorem etcdstart.memberUpOn_served [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ :
    apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames GF) (id : w64) (γa : auth.AuthNames) :
    etcdstart.memberUpOn s ρ E₀ lg γn id γa ⊢ ∃ E cfg γw, ⌜envAgree E E₀ ∧ E.authMode =
    auth.AuthMode.on γa ∧ cfg.Logger' = lg ∧ cfg.TracerOptions' = slice.nil ∧
    cfg.WatchProgressNotifyInterval' = 0⌝ ∗ isServerReqM E.authOn s E { wait := γw, rd := ρ.rd } ∗
    isServerReadM E.authOn s E ρ.rd ∗ srvAuthLb s E ∗ srvServeFacts s E cfg ∗ srvGoRes s ∗
    srvLgReader s ∗ srvBemuReader s ∗ srvWatchReaders s E 64 ∗ etcdstart.kvServeStocks s E ρ.rd ∗
    etcdstart.srvPeerCtl γn s id ∗ □ (srvTLSId s -∗ False) ∗ srvAuthStoreOn s E.RD

def etcdstart.kvServeStocks (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (γr : ReadNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), srvLeadTimeReader s) ∗
      ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (64 - 2) (), srvLgReader s) ∗
        ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), E.RD) ∗
          ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), mvcc.api.mvccReaders E.γ 1) ∗
            ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate etcdstart.memberReadN (), srvReadReader s γr) ∗
              [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), srvBemuReader s)

theorem etcdstart.grpcUp_noRefusal [HasExt idIssueExt] [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] [cache_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ : ReqNames) (γr :
    ReadNames) (gs : Loc) (lis : GoInterface) (addr : GoString) (cid mid : w64) (R : v3rpc.WSrv GF)
    (HEo : E.authOn = false) : isServerReq s E ρ ∗ etcdstart.grpcUp s E ρ γr gs lis addr cid mid R ⊢
    etcdstart.grpcUp s E ρ γr gs lis addr cid mid R ∗ ⌜noRefusalAt addr⌝

theorem etcdstart.memberUp_served [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ :
    apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames GF) (id : w64) (m : lease.Mode) : etcdstart.memberUp s
    ρ E₀ lg γn id m ⊢ ∃ E cfg γw, ⌜envAgree E E₀ ∧ E.authOn = false ∧ cfg.Logger' = lg ∧
    cfg.TracerOptions' = slice.nil ∧ cfg.WatchProgressNotifyInterval' = 0⌝ ∗ isServerReq s E { wait
    := γw, rd := ρ.rd } ∗ isServerRead s E ρ.rd ∗ srvServeFacts s E cfg ∗ srvGoRes s ∗ srvLgReader s
    ∗ srvBemuReader s ∗ srvWatchReaders s E 64 ∗ etcdstart.kvServeStocks s E ρ.rd ∗
    etcdstart.srvPeerCtl γn s id ∗ etcdstart.srvLeaseRd s E m
